tools.name: search_projects
tools.description: Search Git.Top projects by query, category, deployment, difficulty, language, or Cloudflare readiness. Results include project_kind and collection_metadata for resource hubs and curated collections. On large corpora, inspect metadata.candidate_retrieval and metadata.truncated before treating broad r

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Return structured Git.Top knowledge for a project or collection, including the compact agent summary, overview, alternatives, deployments, quality score, agent score, project_kind, and collection_metadata when applicable. Prefer search_projects first when the canonical owner/repo id is uncertain.

tools.name: recommend_project
tools.description: Recommend open source projects for a concrete agent use case and constraints. Provide use_case (or goal/intent/useCase) and optionally constraints or direct deployment/category/language/difficulty/license/cloudflare_ready filters.

tools.name: get_agent_workflow
tools.description: Return a structured Git.Top workflow that guides an agent from trends to recommendations, graph, alternatives, score, compare, and trust checks.

tools.name: compare_projects
tools.description: Compare projects by deployment, maintenance, difficulty, Cloudflare readiness, and use case fit.
